skill.label: Niwabi Fire-Dance
skill.reason: Her Skill makes her Normal Attacks Pyro and multiplies their damage for 10 seconds, which is when she uses them.

c1.label: Constellation 1 after a defeat
c1.reason: Needs an enemy defeated inside her Burst's mark.

c2.label: Constellation 2 after a critical hit
c2.reason: A Constellation 2 window that starts after her Pyro damage lands a critical hit.

a1.label: Tricks of the Trouble-Maker stacks
a1.reason: Each Normal Attack shot during Niwabi Fire-Dance adds 2% Pyro DMG Bonus for up to ten stacks, which a few shots reach; she shoots throughout the Skill.
